scope: Four unique print files, not 22 independent slicing jobs. This is the slicing/support subreview only.
required_print_conditions: Use supplied bed orientations, 100% scale, four unique files in physical quantities 1+1+10+10; not overview STL.

Main body must be re-sliced with transverse/short-axis platform bridges and support not skipped for those bridges; inspect the actual path coordinates and all added support at real-machine settings. Original auto bridge profile is not accepted manufacturing proof.
Generic reference assumes 0.4mm nozzle, 0.2mm layers, 0.45mm specified line width, 3 perimeters, 15% stars infill, PLA, 250x210mm bed. Real printer calibration required.

The approximately 8.225mm main and 8.036mm canopy internal closures require calibrated flow/cooling/bridge ability; otherwise use denser local infill or solid layers and re-slice. Do not describe all bridges as 2.6mm sockets.

Before gluing, fragment shallow-window support from the side via the 4.5x9.4mm exterior corridor with fine angled tools. Do not pull a whole block forward or lever stairs/mullions. If access/adhesion is unsuitable, change support strategy and re-slice.
Canopy warp/bed adhesion and delicate upper frames remain risks. No brim was used in the reference G-code; any added brim must be separately removed and fit rechecked.
limitations: No machine execution, physical trial print, dry fit, support removal, brim removal, glue-strength or large-canopy warp test.
Centerline capsule coverage describes planned bead footprints; it does not validate molten-bead shape, adhesion or sag.
At-most-1mm point samples, eight direction rays and selected radius rays are finite checks, not all-surface/all-direction support-removal or swept-tool proof.
The same geometry is open to the exterior, but support mass can obstruct the route; progressive fragmentation and the complete tool shape were not simulated.
